# Draft:Car Factory Empire

Car Factory Empire is a computer game that combines a global strategy, a car factory simulator and a car simulator. The developer and publisher of the game is the Russian studio RDS Games. The computer game will be released for the Microsoft Windows platform in the spring of 2025. The events of the game take place in a universe that resembles the beginning of the 20th century. The game was released on Steam and VK Play on February 3, 2025.
Plot
The game takes place at the beginning of the industrial era, in a world reminiscent of the United States of the 1910s. The player will have to create a car company from scratch. Repeat the path of famous car tycoons. The player can choose the difficulty of the game, the name and logo of his brand. The plot is non-linear and depends on the player's decisions, but involves going through all the stages of mechanical engineering of that era with the end of the main company in the 1940s.
About the game
Development
A Russian indie studio consisting of several people has been developing the game for 3 years. The project was in an uncertain status for quite a long time, but in early February 2025, the game got a page on Steam and VK Play. According to the developers, the game will be released in early access in the spring of 2025 between April and May. By the time of release, the studio promised support for Steam achievements, support for Russian and English languages, as well as fully functioning gameplay. After the release, the developers promise support for at least a year and a half. The studio's plans include expanding the game's geography, introducing new time periods and types of cars.
